alltext:
5.
The FOREST MINISTER keeps thinking. The TV in the background
continues to show a program on a demigod/Baba type
personality.
FOREST MINISTER
(Loudly)
Aa sound tagginchu! Mimalni kaadhu,
aa bhakti channel petkunna aa donga
baabani okati kottaali
The TV's volume goes down
LEAD GOON
Veedeni em cheddham? Champeyanaa?
The FOREST MINISTER pauses. He glances at both the TV and
SURESH.
LEAD GOON
Entanna alochistunnaavu..
FOREST MINISTER
Veedini Baabani cheyyandi
LEAD GOON
Baabana? Enduku anna karchu?
FOREST MINISTER
Karchu janaalu chuskuntaaru, manaku
kaavalsindhi moogodu. Vaadu ela
untaado manaki telidhu...Vaadu
bayataki raavalante veedu
velugolooki raavali...mana
nalladanaanni telupu ki
marchadaaniki yantram kaavaali...
CUT TO:
19 INT. MINISTER'S HOUSE - NIGHT
SUPERIMPOSE: 2016
The FOREST MINISTER is watching TV, which is playing a
commercial of CHINTHAN BABA's Cola-flavored Goumuutram. He is
flanked by VASU, who seems like he is waiting on the FOREST
MINISTER, but can't do anything about it.
FOREST MINISTER
Edi popularity roju roju ki ee
pichi janallo perigipotundi kani aa
pichodu maatram dorakatledhu.
